keys.series: one entry per panel of the state, keyed crop_code|season: the area-weighted average of the state's reporting units in the shape of a unit record (obs the weighted mean yield per year over the units reporting it, trend and trend_anomaly fitted to that series, enso and weather_history the weighted means, weather the weighted season so far with percentiles null, weather_expected the weighted expectations); responses carry the weighted mean slope per weather variable and, as yield_response_components stores local slopes and covered baseline production; sum each member's exp(beta*x)-1 contrast. relationship_history averages the model-neutral member anomalies and exposures available each year. Aggregate historical confidence bands are not supplied; outlook ranges use shared fields.
